help.text:
Usage:  docker compose [OPTIONS] COMMAND

Define and run multi-container applications with Docker

Options:
      --all-resources              Include all resources, even those not
                                   used by services
      --ansi string                Control when to print ANSI control
                                   characters ("never"|"always"|"auto")
                                   (default "auto")
      --compatibility              Run compose in backward compatibility mode
      --dry-run                    Execute command in dry run mode
      --env-file stringArray       Specify an alternate environment file
  -f, --file stringArray           Compose configuration files
      --parallel int               Control max parallelism, -1 for
                                   unlimited (default -1)
      --profile stringArray        Specify a profile to enable
      --progress string            Set type of progress output (auto,
                                   tty, plain, json, quiet)
      --project-directory string   Specify an alternate working directory
                                   (default: the path of the, first
                                   specified, Compose file)
  -p, --project-name string        Project name

Management Commands:
  bridge                  Convert compose files into another model

Commands:
  attach                  Attach local standard input, output, and error streams to a service's running container
  build                   Build or rebuild services
  commit                  Create a new image from a service container's changes
  config                  Parse, resolve and render compose file in canonical format
  cp                      Copy files/folders between a service container and the local filesystem
  create                  Creates containers for a service
  down                    Stop and remove containers, networks
  events                  Receive real time events from containers
  exec                    Execute a command in a running container
  export                  Export a service container's filesystem as a tar archive
  images                  List images used by the created containers
  kill                    Force stop service containers
  logs                    View output from containers
  ls                      List running compose projects
  pause                   Pause services
  port                    Print the public port for a port binding
  ps                      List containers
  publish                 Publish compose application
  pull                    Pull service images
  push                    Push service images
  restart                 Restart service containers
  rm                      Removes stopped service containers
  run                     Run a one-off command on a service
  scale                   Scale services 
  start                   Start services
  stats                   Display a live stream of container(s) resource usage statistics
  stop                    Stop services
  top                     Display the running processes
  unpause                 Unpause services
  up                      Create and start containers
  version                 Show the Docker Compose version information
  volumes                 List volumes
  wait                    Block until containers of all (or specified) services stop.
  watch                   Watch build context for service and rebuild/refresh containers when files are updated

Run 'docker compose COMMAND --help' for more information on a command.

--abort-on-container-exit.help: Stops all containers if any container was stopped. Incompatible with -d

--abort-on-container-failure.help: Stops all containers if any container exited with failure. Incompatible with -d

--all.help: Include containers created by the run command

--all-resources.help: Include all resources, even those not used by services

--ansi.help: Control when to print ANSI control characters ("never"|"always"|"auto") (default "auto")

--attach.help: Restrict attaching to the specified services. Incompatible with --attach-dependencies.

--attach-dependencies.help: Automatically attach to log output of dependent services

--compatibility.help: Run compose in backward compatibility mode

--compress.help: Compress the build context using gzip. DEPRECATED

--detach.help: Detached mode: Run command in the background

--detach-keys.help: Override the key sequence for detaching from a container.

--down-project.help: Drops project when the first container stops

--dry-run.help: Execute command in dry run mode

--entrypoint.help: Override the entrypoint of the image

--exit-code-from.help: Return the exit code of the selected service container. Implies --abort-on-container-exit

--filter.help: Filter services by a property (supported filters: status)

--follow-link.help: Always follow symbol link in SRC_PATH

--force-recreate.help: Recreate containers even if their configuration and image haven't changed

--hash.help: Print the service config hash, one per line.

--ignore-buildable.help: Ignore images that can be built

--ignore-pull-failures.help: Pull what it can and ignores images with pull failures

--ignore-push-failures.help: Push what it can and ignores images with push failures

--image.help: Include service's image name in output graph

--images.help: Print the image names, one per line.

--include-deps.help: Also pull services declared as dependencies

--indentation-size.help: Number of tabs or spaces to use for indentation

--index.help: index of the container if service has multiple replicas.

--insecure-registry.help: Use insecure registry to pull Compose OCI artifacts. Doesn't apply to images

--interactive.help: Keep STDIN open even if not attached

--json.help: Output events as a stream of json objects

--lock-image-digests.help: Produces an override file with image digests

--menu.help: Enable interactive shortcuts when running attached. Incompatible with --detach. Can also be enable/disable by setting COMPOSE_MENU environment var.

--models.help: Print the model names, one per line.

--name.help: Project name to set in the Compose file

--networks.help: Print the network names, one per line.

--no-attach.help: Do not attach (stream logs) to the specified services

--no-build.help: Don't build an image, even if it's policy

--no-cache.help: Do not use cache when building the image

--no-consistency.help: Don't check model consistency - warning: may produce invalid Compose output

--no-recreate.help: If containers already exist, don't recreate them. Incompatible with --force-recreate.

--no-rm.help: Do not remove intermediate containers after a successful build. DEPRECATED

--no-start.help: Don't start the services after creating them

--no-stream.help: Disable streaming stats and only pull the first result

--no-tty.help: Disable pseudo-TTY allocation. By default 'docker compose exec' allocates a TTY.

--no-up.help: Do not build & start services before watching

--oci-version.help: OCI image/artifact specification version (automatically determined by default)

--orphans.help: Include orphaned services (not declared by project)

--output.help: The output directory for the Kubernetes resources

--ports.help: Include service's exposed ports in output graph

--privileged.help: Give extended privileges to the process

--profiles.help: Print the profile names, one per line.

--progress.help: Set type of progress output (auto, tty, plain, json, quiet)

--project-dir.help: Directory to use for the project

--project-directory.help: Specify an alternate working directory (default: the path of the, first specified, Compose file)

--publish.help: Publish a container's port(s) to the host

--pull.help: Always attempt to pull a newer version of the image

--quiet-build.help: Suppress progress output from the build process

--remove-orphans.help: Remove containers for services not defined in the Compose file

--renew-anon-volumes.help: Recreate anonymous volumes instead of retrieving data from the previous containers

--rm.help: Automatically remove the container when it exits

--scale.help: Scale SERVICE to NUM instances. Overrides the `scale` setting in the Compose file if present.

--service-ports.help: Run command with all service's ports enabled and mapped to the host

--services.help: Print the service names, one per line.

--sig-proxy.help: Proxy all received signals to the process

--signal.help: SIGNAL to send to the container

--since.help: Show all events created since timestamp

--spaces.help: If given, space character ' ' will be used to indent,\notherwise tab character '\t' will be used

--ssh.help: Set SSH authentications used when building service images. (use 'default' for using your default SSH Agent)

--status.help: Filter services by status. Values: [paused | restarting | removing | running | dead | created | exited]

--stop.help: Stop the containers, if required, before removing

--tail.help: Number of lines to show from the end of the logs for each container

--timeout.help: Specify a shutdown timeout in seconds

--transformation.help: Transformation to apply to compose model (default: docker/compose-bridge-kubernetes)

--use-aliases.help: Use the service's network useAliases in the network(s) the container connects to

--user.help: Run the command as this user

--variables.help: Print model variables and default values.

--version.help: Show the Docker Compose version information

--volumes.help: Print the volume names, one per line.

--wait.help: Wait for services to be running|healthy. Implies detached mode.

--wait-timeout.help: Maximum duration in seconds to wait for the project to be running|healthy

--watch.help: Watch source code and rebuild/refresh containers when files are updated.

--with-env.help: Include environment variables in the published OCI artifact

--workdir.help: DEPRECATED! USE --project-directory INSTEAD.\nSpecify an alternate working directory\n(default: the path of the, first specified, Compose file)
